gio ramos: hey everyone! i'm gio — joined today on infra eng. big fan of weekend hikes and gelato. desk plant arriving tomorrow named 'sputnik' :seedling: excited to meet y'all
welcome-bot: Welcome to Redwood, Gio! :tada: Check out #new-hires resources & badge pickup in #people-ops
mai nguyen: welcome @gio! where's your badge pickup? (i'll bring a spare sticker pack if you like)
lucas reed: hi hi — team lunch friday if you're around. also vinyl swap at 4pm, bring something obscure :records: 
anya patel: @gio :wave: shout if you want a hiking crew — we do Marin on saturdays. favorite gelato flavor?
gio ramos: thanks!!! favorite gelato = pistachio. Marin sounds awesome — would love to join.
sarah cho: PSA: rooftop plants are being rehomed tomorrow, plz label seats if you care about plant custody :raised_hands: 
tom keller: lucas — bringing that weird 70s prog record?
lucas reed: @tom yep it's the one with the weird theremin solo :laughing: 
mira patel: welcome! desk 4B has a spare power strip. ping me for keys.
gio ramos: dashboard access came through, just need the VPN. @people-ops any ETA?
people-ops-bot: People Ops note: Badge ready at reception. VPN invite sent to gio.r@redwood.ai — check spam.
anya patel: also optional: first friday playlist vote here — what's your top 3 songs in 1 line?
gio ramos: 1) Fleetwood Mac - The Chain 2) Sufjan Stevens - Chicago 3) Daft Punk - Instant Crush
mai nguyen: welcome again!! :confetti_ball:
